title: Without Settings — Parts the Parts group is hidden and a link is restricted
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has 'See Financial Data' but not 'Settings — Parts'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Have the address of Settings › Pricing copied from an Admin session (for example the page's link).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings.
  2. Open the copied Settings › Pricing address.
  3. Click Go to home.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Settings opens with its other groups.
  • It has no Parts group (no Categories, Pricing or Bin Locations).

Step 2:

  • The page reads "Access restricted" and "Looks like you don't have access to this page. Reach out to your administrator to request access.", with Go to home.

Step 3:

  • The home page opens.
